lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately 4-6 visible vertical columns of high-luminance circular spots posterior to the fifth gill slit, arranged in a grid-like configuration with spots spaced roughly equidistantly.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity align with the centers of the circular spots, creating a lattice pattern on the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient from high luminance on the dorsal edge to low-luminance shadow on the ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin exhibits a high-density distribution of high-luminance blobs, including a specific cluster of approximately 12-15 spots visible on the dorsal surface of the distal-posterior section.
